{{dablink|For other uses of the word "dragon," see [[Dragon (disambiguation)|Dragon]].}} 
The '''Steward of the Dragon''' is a title given to those people granted rule over a territory or nation by [[Rand al'Thor]], while there were not available rightful rulers.

==Notable Stewards==
Stewards were assigned in [[Tear]], [[Cairhien]], and [[Illian]] after the Dragon conquered these kingdoms.
===Cairhien===
Since the liberation of Cairhien from the [[Shaido]], the Dragon choose to support [[Elayne]] as the legitimate ruler, but meanwhile [[Berelain sur Paendrag Paeron]] and [[Rhuarc]] ruled together and briefly the kingdom, before Dobraine was officially assigned. They can be considered as the first unofficial Stewards of the Dragon over Cairhien.

After [[Dumai's Wells]] battle the cairhienin noble [[Dobraine Taborwin]] was officially appointed as Steward of the Dragon in Cairhien, and he ruled for a quite long period{{ref/book|9|p}}, with the aid of some Aes Sedai and Aiel.

Finally when Dobraine was sent by Rand to [[Arad Doman]] the two [[Aes Sedai]] [[Sashalle Anderly]] and [[Samitsu Tamagowa]] took unofficially the stewardship of Cairhien for a while, until the coming of [[Elayne]] as new queen{{ref/book|13|52}}.

===Tear===
The Steward assigned to Tear{{ref/book|9|25}} was [[Darlin Sisnera]], who has since been raised to be the first King of Tear{{ref/book|11|21}}.

===Illian===
In [[Illian]], after Rand was chosen as King, he left [[Gregorin den Lushenos]] as his Steward during his frequent periods of absence{{ref/book|9|p}}.

==Other more brief or particular cases of stewardship==

===Caemlyn and Andor===
After the conquest of Caemlyn against [[Rahvin]], Rand proclaimed that the legitimate ruler was Elayne and that he was waiting for her return. During his frequent absences from Caemlyn, instead than appointing an official Steward Rand left the rule to an informal stewardship council leaded by Lord [[Bashere]], [[Bael]] and [[Melaine]].

===Arad Doman===
Initially Rand transferred Lord Dobrain from Cairhien to Bandar Eban as his Steward, but the situation worsened and soon the forces of the Dragon were forced to abandon the city. After his second return to Arad Doman Rand appointed [[Iralin]] {{ref/book|13|25}} as his Steward in the city of Bandar Eban.

===Two Rivers===
[[Elayne Trakand]], when officially recognized as Queen of Andor, appointed [[Perrin Aybara]] Steward of the Dragon in the [[Two Rivers]]{{ref/book|13|47}} to justify Perrin's ''de facto'' lordship over that region in front of the Andoran nobility. Perrin in turn appointed [[Tam al'Thor]] as Lord and Steward during his absence.

==Parallels==
Steward figures have been common in human history [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steward_(office)] and they might best be compared to the governors that controlled Imperial Territories in the Roman Empire.
